use default
use Raster.Anchor
use Raster.IMAGE

use EDGE = (start: string, finish: string, cost: int)
use REACHED = (cost: int, previous: string)

shortest_paths(edges: EDGE[], nodes: string[], source: string)
    -> MAP[string, REACHED] is
    let best = MAP[string, REACHED]()
    let unvisited = LIST(nodes)

    best[source] = (cost = 0, previous = "")

    while let nearest = unvisited
        |> filter(node => best.contains_key(node))
        |> min_by(node => best[node].cost)
    do
        unvisited.remove(nearest)

        for edge in edges |> filter(edge => edge.start =~ nearest) do
            let through = best[nearest].cost + edge.cost

            if !best.contains_key(edge.finish) \/
                through < best[edge.finish].cost then
                best[edge.finish] = (cost = through, previous = nearest)
            fi
        od
    od

    best
si

let edges = [
    (start = "a", finish = "b", cost = 7),
    (start = "a", finish = "c", cost = 9),
    (start = "a", finish = "f", cost = 14),
    (start = "b", finish = "c", cost = 10),
    (start = "b", finish = "d", cost = 15),
    (start = "c", finish = "d", cost = 11),
    (start = "c", finish = "f", cost = 2),
    (start = "d", finish = "e", cost = 6),
    (start = "e", finish = "f", cost = 9)]

let nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"]

let places = MAP[string, (x: double, y: double)]()
let labels = MAP[string, (x: double, y: double)]()

place(node: string, x: double, y: double, at: double, above: double) is
    places[node] = (x = x, y = y)
    labels[node] = (x = at, y = above)
si

place("a", 0.0, 1.0, -0.05, 0.68)
place("b", 1.5, 2.0, 1.12, 2.30)
place("c", 1.5, 1.0, 1.00, 0.70)
place("d", 3.0, 2.0, 3.08, 2.30)
place("e", 4.0, 1.0, 4.00, 0.68)
place("f", 2.2, 0.0, 2.20, -0.32)

let best = shortest_paths(edges, nodes, "a")

on_tree(edge: EDGE) -> bool =>
    best.contains_key(edge.finish) /\
        best[edge.finish].previous =~ edge.start

let tree_colour = (red = 35ub, green = 85ub, blue = 170ub)
let other_colour = (red = 190ub, green = 194ub, blue = 205ub)
let ink = (red = 55ub, green = 60ub, blue = 75ub)

let image = IMAGE(740, 520)

image.view(-0.45, -0.45, 4.55, 2.95, 20.0)

across(pixels: double) -> double =>
    image.to_user(pixels, 0.0).x - image.to_user(0.0, 0.0).x

down(pixels: double) -> double =>
    image.to_user(0.0, 0.0).y - image.to_user(0.0, pixels).y

label(x: double, y: double, height: double, text: string) is
    let half = across(image.text_width(height, text) / 2.0 + 4.0)

    image.colour(255ub, 255ub, 255ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(
        x - half, y - down(4.0), x + half, y + down(height + 2.0))

    image.colour(ink)
    image.text(x, y, height, text, Anchor.CENTRE)
si

for edge in edges do
    let from = places[edge.start]
    let to = places[edge.finish]

    if on_tree(edge) then
        image.colour(tree_colour)
        image.stroke(3.5)
    else
        image.colour(other_colour)
        image.stroke(2.0)
    fi

    image.line(from.x, from.y, to.x, to.y)
od

for edge in edges do
    let from = places[edge.start]
    let to = places[edge.finish]

    label(
        (from.x + to.x) / 2.0,
        (from.y + to.y) / 2.0 - down(5.0),
        13.0, "{edge.cost}")
od

for node in nodes do
    let place = places[node]

    let at = labels[node]

    label(at.x, at.y, 14.0, "cost {best[node].cost}")

    image.colour(tree_colour)
    image.dot(place.x, place.y, 16.0)

    image.colour(255ub, 255ub, 255ub)
    image.text(place.x, place.y - down(6.0), 17.0, node, Anchor.CENTRE)
od

image.colour(ink)
image.text(
    -0.4, 2.80, 15.0,
    "shortest path tree from a, with edge costs")

image.write("dijkstra.png")

image.show("dijkstra.png")
